reviewRequired.note: Sydney Harbour Bridge is not precisely a bowstring/tied arch; closest source option is A.
Both running child and moving wings of hovering bee have kinetic energy.
Force magnitudes and initial velocity are unspecified; movement is not uniquely determined.
Two choices (B and C) are incorrect, so this is not single-answer MC.
Moving down a hill does not exclude gravitational potential energy.
Source figure says700N and50kg, whereas written problem says400N and20kg. Accept a consistent interpretation; supplied worked solution uses the written values.
